packageRules.description: Open the PR and merge it automatically once checks pass when Renovate rates the update high or very high merge confidence
The Flutter plugin loader is provided by the local Flutter SDK (includeBuild in settings.gradle), not a Maven repository, so Renovate cannot look it up
typescript-eslint (via eslint-config-next) and Next.js need the TypeScript JS API, which TypeScript 7 no longer ships; keep the web app below 6.1 until they support it
